```sql
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  SUM(fgm) AS fgm_total,
  SUM(fga) AS fga_attempts,
  CAST(SUM(fgm) AS DOUBLE) / SUM(fga) AS fg_pct
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
HAVING SUM(fga) >= 100
ORDER BY fg_pct DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
